title: थारू, मगर र कुमाल जातिमा प्रचलित सोरठीनाचका पात्रका  भूमिकाको तुलना
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख थारू, मगर र कुमाल जातिमा प्रचलित सोरठी नाचका पात्रहरूको भूमिकागत तुलना गर्नुमा केन्द्रित छ । थारू नेपालको तराई र मगर तथा कुमाल मध्यपहाडी भूभागमा बसोवास गर्ने जाति विशेष हुन् जसको आआफ्नै भाषा, संस्कृति, रीतिरिवाज र परम्परा, भाषा, साहित्य र लोकसाहित्य छ । लोकसाहित्यका नृत्यनाट्य विधाहरू विशेष मनोरञ्जन प्रदान गर्ने सामूहिक प्रकृतिका हुन्छन् । यिनका विषय र प्रस्तुति शैलीमा जाति, भाषा, संस्कृति र भूगोलअनुसार भिन्न भिन्न रहे पनि कतिपय विषय भने समान प्रकृतिका पनि हुन्छन् जसमा सम्बन्धित जाति र भूगोलको अभिव्यक्ति पाइन्छ । यसै अन्तर्गत सोरठी नृत्यनाट्यको प्रस्तुति गर्ने कार्य पनि पर्दछ । अध्ययनीय सोरठीका चारित्रिक भूमिकामा समान विषयका कारणले केही साम्य र भिन्न भिन्न जाति, भाषा, संस्कृति र भूगोलका कारणले चारित्रिक भूमिकामा आगम, लोप, अनुकूलन, विपर्यय र परिवर्तन जस्ता प्रभावक तत्त्व घटित भई वैषम्य पनि पाइन्छ । यस्ता साम्य र वैषम्यको पहिचान तुलनात्मक अध्ययनबाट गर्न सकिन्छ । तुलनाका पनि विभिन्न सम्प्रदायमध्ये यस आलेखमा मुख्यतः अमेरिकी सम्प्रदायद्वारा स्थापित सौन्दर्यात्मक सम्बन्धको खोजी र अंशतः रुसी सम्प्रदायद्वारा स्थापित साहित्यको समाजसँग सम्बन्ध हुन्छ भन्ने मान्यताका आधारमा पात्रमा सादृश्यमूलक सम्बन्ध, पात्रका परम्परित भूमिका, पात्र प्रयोगमा प्रभावपरकता, पात्र प्रयोगमा स्वीकृति तथा सञ्चारणता एवम् विषयवस्तु चयन, पाठ प्रस्तुति र भाषा प्रयोगमा प्रेरणा, प्रभाव र साम्य जस्ता बुँदालाई विश्लेष्य तत्त्वका लिई तीनवटै सोरठीमा प्रयुक्त पात्रका भूमिकाको तुलनात्मक विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: This article focuses on comparing the role-based differences of the characters in the Sorathi dance prevalent among the Tharu, Magar and Kumal castes. The Tharu are a particular caste living in the Terai of Nepal, and the Magar and Kumal in the mid-hill region, each with its own language, culture, customs and traditions, language, literature and folk literature. The dance-drama genres of folk literature are of a collective nature, providing special entertainment. Although their subject matter and presentation style differ according to caste, language, culture and geography, some subjects are also of a similar nature, in which the expression of the related caste and geography is found. The performance of the Sorathi dance-drama also falls under this. In the character roles of the Sorathi under study, some similarities occur due to common subjects, and, due to different castes, languages, cultures and geographies, influential factors such as arrival, loss, adaptation, inversion and change occur in the character roles, resulting in dissimilarity as well. Such similarities and dissimilarities can be identified through comparative study. Among the various schools of comparison, this article is mainly based on the American school's established aesthetic relationship and partly on the Russian school's established view that literature relates to society, and on this basis the comparative analysis of the roles of the characters used in all three Sorathis has been carried out, taking as analytical elements the analogical relationship among characters, the traditional roles of characters, the effectiveness of character use, the acceptability and communicability of character use, and inspiration, influence and similarity in subject matter selection, text presentation and language use.

informal_english: This article is all about comparing the roles of the characters in the Sorathi dance that's popular among the Tharu, Magar and Kumal. The Tharu are a particular caste living in Nepal's Terai, and the Magar and Kumal in the mid-hills, each with its own language, culture, customs and traditions, literature and folk literature. The dance-drama genres of folk literature are collective affairs that give special entertainment. The Sorathi dance-drama performance falls under this as well. In the character roles of the Sorathi studied here, some similarities come from common subjects, and because of different castes, languages, cultures and geographies, influential factors like arrival, loss, adaptation, inversion and change crop up in the character roles, so there's dissimilarity as well. Such similarities and dissimilarities can be picked up through comparative study.
